params.text: surface form, in any language or script
params.domain: optional domain restricting which instruments (zeros) are available; None lets all play

Understand.read.returns: the word mapped to a Riemann zero in semantic space

params.description: text saying where meaning starts and stops; its token count sets the width of the zero window

Understand.describe.returns: the semantic domain centred on the description's zero

params.signal: acoustic samples of a speech waveform

Understand.listen.returns: the word whose semantic prime the formant structure points at

Understand.ponder.returns: the word carrying its conserved prime E

params.operations: functions SemanticWord → SemanticWord to apply; None uses the registered default stack

Understand.calculate.returns: the word with the operations' projections attached

Understand.understand.returns: the word reduced to its DC component: the prime

Understand.process.doc:
Run the full pipeline in one call: Read → Ponder → Calculate → Understand.

Input is any surface form in any language or script; output is the
semantic prime as multidimensional context.

params.operations: operations for the calculate step; None uses the default stack
params.t: evolution time for the ponder step
params.domain: optional SemanticDomain from describe() constraining the semantic space
domain whose coherence time sets the Capacitor time constant
